d:
In her rush, Daya calls Gada Electronics and tells Natu Kaka to book urgent flight tickets. Natu Kaka ends up booking expensive, non-refundable business class tickets. Jethalal tries to cancel them, but realizing the money won't be refunded, he calms Daya down and promises to track Sundar from Mumbai instead.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
